executive_summary.headline: Macro conditions deteriorated this cycle as US outlook shifted to declining and Philip Morris fell sharply; shipping through Hormuz has collapsed and energy prices remain elevated.
executive_summary.next_step: Convene procurement and supply planning within 48 hours to review commodity hedges and Hormuz-dependent route inventory given the 97% drop in Strait transits and elevated EU gas prices.
executive_summary.context: The macro pillar flipped AMBER today following a US outlook downgrade, mirroring the earlier EU recovery from AMBER on 13 Nov. Philip Morris fell 3.3% (double its normal range) amid this macro softening. Separately, Strait of Hormuz transits have crashed 97% year-over-year as of 15 Nov, while EU natural gas and aluminium remain 131% and 23% above September baseline respectively, signalling sustained energy and input cost pressure across supply routes.
